verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships each skill as a SKILL.md with explicit trigger and behavior rules (e.g. 'Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response' [superpowers-docs-16], TDD gating rules [superpowers-docs-17]), has a documented testing/evals harness that verifies agents actually comply with skill triggers [superpowers-docs-14, superpowers-docs-30], and release notes describe behavior changes precisely (e.g. worktree removal safeguards, review-fix loop semantics) so developers can track what changed. However there is no single consolidated 'which skill activates when' reference for all 20+ skills, and community feedback shows mixed real-world predictability of outcomes even if triggers are documented (e.g. superpowers-comm-2, superpowers-comm-3), so the promise is only partially borne out in practice. Missing for 10: a consolidated per-skill activation index/table, and independent hands-on confirmation that documented triggers reliably match observed agent behavior across skills.
